---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new check, tool, or capability
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Problem this solves**
What's missing or awkward today? Who runs into this?

**Proposed approach**
How would this work, at a high level?

**Which tool does this belong to?**
(existing tool name, or "new tool", or "installer/packaging")

**Would this need infrastructure beyond a local install?**
(A13x is intentionally zero-infrastructure — server-side or account-based
features need a strong justification; see the project's design rationale
in the README.)
